title: Vibrant Peppery Saudi Arabian Lamb Tagine
description: A peppery and adventurous Saudi-Arabian dish featuring lamb, apple juice, and puff pastry, cooked to perfection in a copper pot.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the lamb pieces with cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in the copper pot over medium heat and sear the lamb until browned.
Add the apple juice to the copper pot and bring to a boil.
Cover the copper pot with puff pastry, cutting a few slits in the top for steam to escape.
Transfer the copper pot to the preheated oven and bake for 2 1/2 hours.
Remove the copper pot from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Serve the lamb tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
